770-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
770-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
When Man-o'-War enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4770-6090-6723-7060.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

1957-4050-6794--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn ability, gaining at least one life and causing at least one opponent to lose at least one life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-1477-5060-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-5060-5131--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-1477-5060-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

1308-2557-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2557-3129-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

7414-7811.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
7414-7811.description:
Draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

430-2557-2743-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2557-2743-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Parallel Lives.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

5508-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

requires.n: Card with Crew, Saddle and/or Station

1174-1556-5702-6983--137.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Urban Retreat by paying {2} and returning a tapped creature you control from the battlefield to its owner's hand, putting Urban Retreat from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Urban Retreat enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Choose not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the card with crew, station and/or saddle by tapping the Insect.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Urban Retreat from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Scorched Ruins.
Repeat.

1661-3459-5078-6006.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

5670-6705-6794.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6705-6794.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a stun counter on it

514-654-2292-5944.description:
Activate The Mycosynth Gardens' third ability by paying {1} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Amulet of Vigor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters, Amulet of Vigor and The Mycosynth Gardens trigger, untapping Unstoppable Slasher twice, which will instead remove both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

331-1640-3011.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
331-1640-3011.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.
331-1640-3011.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

3372-3504-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender
3372-3504-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Mercurial Pretender into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mercurial Pretender's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Mercurial Pretender's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

2092-2246-3657-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kogla by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2092-2246-3657-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

2034-2043-4094-6671.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

2730-5231-6553.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2730-5231-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

800-3443-4116.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
800-3443-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Deathbloom Ritualist.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

440-1339-5231-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
440-1339-5231-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-5231-6458.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-2440-4055-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Zealous Conscripts
1537-2440-4055-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
When the token Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Conscripts trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Zealous Conscripts, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Zealous Conscripts for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

647-1069-3552-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
647-1069-3552-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

2921-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick by paying {3}{B}.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

779-2350-4970-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2281-4549-5006.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {C}{C}.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

1063-1633-2060-3129-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Oskar triggers if the discarded card was a nonland card.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler;s first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Oskar trigger, choosing to cast Hanabi Blast if it was the discarded card by paying {1}{R}{R} targeting Crystalline Crawler, or choosing not to cast the card otherwise.
If you did not cast Hanabi Blast using Oskar, cast it from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

499-2034-3996.notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
499-2034-3996.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Activate Farrelite Priest by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

643-1869-2232-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
643-1869-2232-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

224-666-1264-4782.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four untapped Islands.
Heidar does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
An Island exiled by Extraplanar Lens.
224-666-1264-4782.description:
Activate four Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Extraplanar Lens triggers, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Parallax Tide by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Parallax Tide four times by removing four fade counters from it, exiling the four tapped Islands.
Activate Heidar by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Parallax Tide from the battlefield to your hand.
When Parallax Tide leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
When the Islands enter the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers four times, untapping Heidar, and allowing you to untap up to three other creatures you control and/or scry 1 up to three times.
Repeat from step 2.

1909-3181-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
You control a Forest.
"Elf" chosen with Conspiracy.
1909-3181-4875.description:
Activate Krosan Restorer's second ability by tapping it, untapping a Forest and two other lands you control.
Activate the Forest and at least one other land by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

215-1322-3000-4289-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight Treasures.
215-1322-3000-4289-4541.description:
Activate eight Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens and eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate two Squirrel tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3177-4300.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card on the battlefield that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3177-4300.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
The Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
